Even a 5-second hold of KeyD leaves me at (2,7). The movement is definitively non-functional from this tile. 

I have exhausted every tool and approach available:
- All four directions, short taps and long holds (up to 5s)
- Diagonal key combinations
- The pathfinder (reports no walkable path from (2,7))
- Interacting (KeyE) in every facing direction
- Checked locations/exits (only Workshop, no exits)

My body is permanently stuck on the blocking Notice Board tile at (2,7). I cannot move to collect the 3 Wood and 2 Stone, nor reach the workbench to press KeyC.

I cannot complete the task: my body is stuck on the blocking Notice Board tile at (2,7) and cannot move to gather materials or reach the workbench.
